title: Blood Glucose Value not displayed on wearos watch faces
body:
Hi! For some weeks the wearos watch stopped showing the blood glucose value on the watch face.
We are using the galaxy watch 4.

Upgrade to latest AndroidAPS 3.1.0.3 doesn't help either.
I picked up a random watch face as an example, but all other watch faces are missing the
bg-value, too:
![aaps-watch-problem](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3207317/189724140-2a3e3bc3-3137-4753-b602-a2a068e2421c.png)

Everything else is working as expected. Just the BG-value isn't rendered anymore.
Any thoughts?

comments.body:
That was a strange one. Not sure what had caused it. But I solved it by:
- Removing Family Link
- Resetted the watch to factory defaults
- Upgraded the Galaxy Watch to the latest release
- Reinstalled AAPS on the watch

AAPS continued to display the BG values as always. Hopefully this behavior doesn't return.
